name: Aloo Paratha
instructions: Prepare potato filling, stuff it into dough, roll and cook on a pan.

name: Tomato Pasta
ingredients: pasta, tomato, onion, garlic, oil, salt
instructions: Boil pasta, cook onion and garlic, add tomato and mix with pasta.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
ingredients: rice, carrot, peas, onion, soy sauce, oil
instructions: Stir-fry vegetables, add cooked rice and soy sauce, then mix.

name: Masala Omelette

name: Paneer Masala

instructions: Cook the vegetables and spices, add paneer and cook.

name: Poha

name: Vegetable Sandwich

instructions: Put vegetables and cheese between bread and toast.
